title: Verbs of perception: I saw him leave, I heard her singing

objective.en: Say what you saw, heard or noticed with a perception verb + object + -ing for an action in progress, or + base form for a whole action: I heard someone shouting. I saw him wink.
objective.fr: Dire ce que vous avez vu, entendu ou remarqué avec un verbe de perception + objet + -ing pour une action en cours, ou + forme de base pour une action entière : I saw him wink.
objective.de: Sagen, was man gesehen, gehört oder bemerkt hat: Wahrnehmungsverb + Objekt + -ing für eine laufende Handlung oder + Grundform für eine ganze Handlung: I heard someone shouting.

instructions.en: Read the explanation and the examples.
instructions.de: Lies die Erklärung und die Beispiele.

text.en:
After `see`, `hear`, `watch`, `notice` and `feel` you can put an **object** and then the **-ing form**. It shows an action that was **in progress**: `I heard someone shouting.`

The object is a noun or an object pronoun: `me`, `him`, `her`, `us`, `them`. Never `he` or `she`: `I saw her crossing the road.`

- `I watched the children playing in the park.`
- `She noticed a man following her.`
- `We felt the ground shaking.`
text.fr:
Après `see`, `hear`, `watch`, `notice` et `feel`, on peut mettre un **complément d’objet** puis la **forme en -ing**. Elle montre une action **en cours** : `I heard someone shouting.`

Le complément est un nom ou un pronom complément : `me`, `him`, `her`, `us`, `them`. Jamais `he` ou `she` : `I saw her crossing the road.`

- `I watched the children playing in the park.`
- `She noticed a man following her.`
- `We felt the ground shaking.`
text.de:
Nach `see`, `hear`, `watch`, `notice` und `feel` kann ein **Objekt** und dann die **-ing-Form** stehen. Sie zeigt eine Handlung, die **gerade im Gange** war: `I heard someone shouting.`

Das Objekt ist ein Nomen oder ein Objektpronomen: `me`, `him`, `her`, `us`, `them`. Nie `he` oder `she`: `I saw her crossing the road.`

- `I watched the children playing in the park.`
- `She noticed a man following her.`
- `We felt the ground shaking.`

label.en: Object + base form: a whole action
label.fr: Objet + forme de base : une action entière

instructions.en: Read the explanation and the examples.
instructions.de: Lies die Erklärung und die Beispiele.

text.en:
Use the **base form** (the infinitive without to) when you saw or heard the **whole action**, from start to finish: `I saw him wink.` `We heard her sing the whole song.`

Compare `I heard her sing.` (the whole song) with `I heard her singing.` (only part of it).

- Never add to after the object: not `I saw him to leave`, but `I saw him leave.`
- A short, quick action usually takes the base form: `I felt something touch my arm.`
- With see, hear and watch both patterns exist: the meaning decides.
text.fr:
Utilisez la **forme de base** (l’infinitif sans to) quand vous avez vu ou entendu l’**action entière**, du début à la fin : `I saw him wink.` `We heard her sing the whole song.`

Comparez `I heard her sing.` (toute la chanson) et `I heard her singing.` (une partie seulement).

- N’ajoutez jamais to après le complément : pas `I saw him to leave`, mais `I saw him leave.`
- Une action courte et rapide prend souvent la forme de base : `I felt something touch my arm.`
- Avec see, hear et watch, les deux structures existent : le sens décide.
text.de:
Verwende die **Grundform** (Infinitiv ohne to), wenn du die **ganze Handlung** vom Anfang bis zum Ende gesehen oder gehört hast: `I saw him wink.` `We heard her sing the whole song.`

Vergleiche `I heard her sing.` (das ganze Lied) mit `I heard her singing.` (nur ein Teil).

- Setze nach dem Objekt nie to: nicht `I saw him to leave`, sondern `I saw him leave.`
- Eine kurze, schnelle Handlung steht meist in der Grundform: `I felt something touch my arm.`
- Bei see, hear und watch gibt es beide Muster: Die Bedeutung entscheidet.
